svg.title: Ὕμνοι: the names in the Homeric Hymns, gathered round the gods the hymns are sung to

g.text: the names in the Homeric Hymns, gathered round the gods the hymns are sung to
a god the hymns are sung to
joins a god to each name in the hymns sung to it
Every name in the thirty-four Homeric Hymns, read line by line in the Greek. Text: H. G. Evelyn-White (1914), via the Perseus Digital Library;
Hymn 34, Εἰς Ξένους, from T. W. Allen (1912). After a graph drawn by hand by Peter Danenberg in 2009, whose topology this is: each hymn folded into the god it is sung to.
